strongest_angle: Chef Marco Pierre White has officially clarified that his long-standing feud with Gordon Ramsay originated from a specific incident involving a camera crew at his 2000 wedding, debunking decades of speculation.

key_facts.fact: Chef Marco Pierre White revealed that his feud with Gordon Ramsay began when Ramsay brought a television camera crew to his wedding in the year 2000.
Gordon Ramsay previously worked as a protégé for Marco Pierre White at his London restaurant, Harveys, for a period of three years.
Marco Pierre White explicitly dismissed alternative rumors that the fallout was caused by arguments over food or Gordon Ramsay leaving the Harveys restaurant.

numbers.label: Years Gordon Ramsay worked at Harveys
